description: Codex host routing defaults. Terra handles economical work; Sol handles demanding architecture, build, and review work.

cheap.notes: Fast, low-cost surveys and routine transformations.

standard.notes: Utility roles and straightforward prompt/document work.

strong.notes: Default for architecture, critique, backend, and frontend first pass.

frontier.notes: Use for final gates, subtle design/code risk, or high-stakes reviews.

escalated.notes: Use after evidence of trouble or explicit human request.

granular-ui-fast.notes: Spark is a fast, less-capable, text-only implementation worker. Use only for the policy-qualified first Mage pass; use the resolved Mage default for every retry, revision, or ineligible task.
